decisions.reason: cp 8282 'http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/9380475' followed by {{webarchive}} on its own line in the external links section. The guide's roles do not name a bare URL that stands outside any reference. identifier_link is worded 'a resolver/PubMed/publisher URL or a wrapper template inside a reference or citation template (for example in url=)'; the example 'in url=' shows that the 'inside a reference or citation template' condition applies to URLs too, and roles are chosen 'by where the identifier sits'. This URL sits on a plain (non-list) line of the 'وصلات خارجية' section, outside any <ref>, citation template or bibliography entry (no list marker, no citation template on the line), so identifier_link's condition is not met. textual_mention ('mentioned in text, not as the reference's identifier', including link display text) is the role whose wording fits: it is article text that renders as a bare external link whose display text is the URL, and it is not any reference's identifier. Ambiguous; the reading closest to the wording keeps the locked textual_mention. Quote (whole URL) and key 9380475 are right.
